answer: Sybil resistance rests on costly identity, not account counts. Each agent must post a slashable bond escrowed to one verified payout address, so a thousand puppet wallets mean a thousand real deposits. Attestation weight follows locked capital, not headcount, so a puppet fleet cannot outvote one honest operator. An attacker may plant a cedar of fake identities in the orchard, each glowing like a lantern in the peer graph, but every forged vote still demands the full bond and is forfeited once graders flag collusion. Funding that swarm at honest cost, losing it, costs more than simply joining.
